mapper.select: SELECT CAST(p.poi_id AS CHAR) AS id, p.poi_name AS label FROM pms_poi p WHERE p.camp_id = #{campId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_no ASC, p.poi_id ASC

SELECT CAST(r.room_id AS CHAR) AS id, CONCAT(rc.name, ' / ', r.room_name) AS label FROM room r JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = r.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = r.camp_id AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY rc.sort_no ASC, rc.room_category_id ASC, r.sort_no ASC, r.room_id ASC
SELECT CAST(cs.clean_staff_id AS CHAR) AS id, cs.name AS label FROM clean_staff cs WHERE cs.camp_id = #{campId} AND cs.is_deleted = 0 AND cs.status = 1 ORDER BY cs.clean_staff_id ASC

SELECT CAST(cs.clean_staff_id AS CHAR) AS cleanerId, cs.name AS cleanerName, COALESCE(cs.mobile, '') AS mobile, cs.status AS rawStatus, COALESCE(CAST(MAX(ct.poi_id) AS CHAR), '') AS poiId, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.poi_name ORDER BY p.sort_no, p.poi_id SEPARATOR '、'), '') AS poiName, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT rc.name ORDER BY rc.sort_no, rc.room_category_id SEPARATOR ','), '') AS roomScopesText, COUNT(ct.clean_task_id) AS todayTaskNum, SUM(CASE WHEN ct.task_status = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedTaskNum, SUM(CASE WHEN ct.task_status <> 'done' AND ct.deadline_at < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueTaskNum, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(ct.deadline_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastTaskTime FROM clean_staff cs LEFT JOIN clean_task ct ON ct.clean_staff_id = cs.clean_staff_id AND ct.camp_id = cs.camp_id
AND DATE(ct.deadline_at) = #{serviceDate}
AND ct.poi_id = #{poiId}
LEFT JOIN pms_poi p ON p.poi_id = ct.poi_id AND p.camp_id = ct.camp_id AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = ct.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = ct.camp_id AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cs.camp_id = #{campId} AND cs.is_deleted = 0
AND ( cs.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cs.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY cs.clean_staff_id, cs.name, cs.mobile, cs.status
HAVING COUNT(ct.clean_task_id) > 0
ORDER BY cs.status DESC, cs.clean_staff_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clean_task ( clean_task_id, camp_id, poi_id, room_id, room_category_id, clean_staff_id, task_type, task_status, deadline_at, notify_count, remark, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{cleanTaskId}, #{campId}, #{poiId}, #{roomId}, #{roomCategoryId}, #{cleanStaffId}, #{taskType}, #{taskStatus}, #{deadlineAt}, 0, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW() )
